section_1.title: The Problem: Context Blindness
section_1.content: Introduce the challenge of reading a long sentence where words depend on previous words (Recurrent Neural Networks). Show how old methods lose context over long distances.
section_1.example: In the sentence 'The bank of the river is muddy,' the word 'bank' is ambiguous. A simple model forgets 'river' by the time it reaches 'bank'.

section_2.title: Prerequisite: Query, Key, and Value (QKV)
section_2.content: Explain the retrieval system analogy. Query (what I want), Key (what I offer), Value (the actual information). Use a graphical 'Library Catalog' analogy.
section_2.example: Think of a student (Query) searching for a book in a library. The book spine label is the 'Key', and the content inside the book is the 'Value'.

section_3.title: The Mechanism: Calculating Attention Scores
section_3.content: Visualizing the Dot Product. Explain that we multiply the Query by the Key to find how much 'attention' word A should pay to word B. Use a heatmap animation.
section_3.example: In 'The cat sat on the mat because it was tired,' calculate the attention scores: 'it' has a high dot-product match with 'cat' (the subject) vs. 'mat' (the object).

section_4.title: Softmax and Weighting
section_4.content: Convert raw scores into probabilities (0-1 range) using Softmax. This ensures the model 'distributes' attention across all words intelligently.
section_4.example: Visualizing a 'Spotlight' beam moving across words. 'it' puts 80% of its spotlight on 'cat' and 20% on 'mat' to resolve ambiguity.

section_5.title: Multi-Head Attention: Seeing the Whole Picture
section_5.content: Explain that one 'head' isn't enough. We run multiple attention layers in parallel to capture different types of relationships (e.g., grammatical vs. semantic).
section_5.example: Like having one editor check for grammar (Head 1) while another checks for the emotional tone of the story (Head 2), combining results for a complete understanding.

storyboard.title: The Problem: Context Blindness
